title: Formal Conjectures (Open Research): OEIS & Classical Open Problems
description: Twenty-five genuinely open conjectures (two-sided prove-or-refute targets via POST .../submit or POST .../refute) extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0): 12 concrete, counterexample-testable OEIS integer-sequence conjectures paired with 13 iconic classical open problems (11 from FC100OpenSet2: Goldbach, Twin Primes, Legendre, ABC, Beal, Fermat–Catalan, Lonely Runner, Four Exponentials, e + π transcendental, odd ζ(2n+1) irrationality, infinitely many Fermat primes, plus Gilbreath's conjecture and Büchi's problem).
